newsitem.title: USA: Universal Int'l Jan same-store sales down.
newsitem.headline: Universal Int'l Jan same-store sales down.

text.p: Universal International Inc on Tuesday said same-store retail sales declined 0.4 percent in January.
It said total sales for the month for its Only Deals and Odd's-N-End's retail outlets rose 37.2 pecent to $3.9 million from $2.9 million in the same 1996 period.

"For February, we expect a difficult period on a comparable-store sales basis given February 1996's comparable store increase of 24.1 percent, which included heavy discounting of 1995 seasonal product," said Chief Executive Mark Ravich in a statement.
"Our goal after February is to achieve positive monthly comparable-store sales results for the balance of the year," he added.
Universal International buys and sells close-out merchandise in both its wholesale business and its retail store chains.
